    84	        group_count = std::min(group_count, point_count - count);
    85	
    86	        while (group_count > 0) {
    87	            const double sign = (frand() < 0.5) ? -1.0 : 1.0;
    88	            const double r = frand() * radius;
    89	            const double dx = (2.0 * frand() - 1.0) * r;
    90	            const double dy = std::sqrt(r * r - dx * dx) * sign;
    91	            const double x = center_x + dx;
    92	            const double y = center_y + dy;
    93	
    94	            if (x < 0.0 || x > MAX_WIDTH || y < 0.0 || y > MAX_HEIGHT) continue;
    95	            points[count++] = {x, y};
    96	            --group_count;
    97	        }
    98	    }
    99	}
   100	
   101	inline double pointDistance(const Point& first, const Point& second) {
   102	    const double dx = first.x - second.x;
   103	    const double dy = first.y - second.y;
   104	    return std::sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
   105	}
   106	
   107	/*
   108	 * One persistent block evaluates one seed at a time.  Each block owns a row
   109	 * of candidate diameters and obtains new seeds through a global work queue.
   110	 * This keeps exactly the original greedy ordering while avoiding the serial
   111	 * implementation's repeated scan over every member already in the cluster.
   112	 */
   113	template <bool store_members>
   114	__global__ void candidateClustersKernel(const Point* __restrict__ points,
   115	                                        const unsigned char* __restrict__ active,
   116	                                        const int* __restrict__ seeds,
   117	                                        const int seed_count,
   118	                                        const int point_count,
   119	                                        const double threshold,
   120	                                        double* __restrict__ workspace,
   121	                                        int* __restrict__ cardinalities,
   122	                                        int* __restrict__ members,
   123	                                        int* __restrict__ next_seed) {
   124	    __shared__ double reduction_distance[CUDA_THREADS];
   125	    __shared__ int reduction_index[CUDA_THREADS];
   126	    __shared__ int work_index;
   127	
   128	    const int thread = threadIdx.x;
   129	    double* const candidate_diameter =
   130	        workspace + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * point_count;
   131	
   132	    while (true) {
   133	        if (thread == 0) work_index = atomicAdd(next_seed, 1);
   134	        __syncthreads();
   135	
   136	        const int seed_slot = work_index;
   137	        if (seed_slot >= seed_count) return;
   138	
   139	        const int seed = seeds[seed_slot];
   140	        for (int candidate = thread; candidate < point_count;
   141	             candidate += blockDim.x) {
   142	            candidate_diameter[candidate] =
   143	                (active[candidate] != 0 && candidate != seed) ? 0.0 : DBL_MAX;
   144	        }
   145	        if constexpr (store_members) {
   146	            if (thread == 0) {
   147	                members[static_cast<size_t>(seed_slot) * point_count] = seed;
   148	            }
   149	        }
   150	        __syncthreads();
   151	
   152	        int cardinality = 1;
   153	        int last_member = seed;
   154	        while (true) {
   155	            double local_distance = DBL_MAX;
   156	            int local_index = INT_MAX;
   157	            const Point member_point = points[last_member];
   158	
   159	            // Update each candidate's maximum distance and reduce by the
   160	            // lexicographic key (diameter, point index).  The point-index tie
   161	            // break is the sequential candidate-loop rule.
   162	            for (int candidate = thread; candidate < point_count;
   163	                 candidate += blockDim.x) {
   164	                double diameter = candidate_diameter[candidate];
   165	                if (diameter == DBL_MAX) continue;
   166	
   167	                const double dx = points[candidate].x - member_point.x;
   168	                const double dy = points[candidate].y - member_point.y;
   169	                const double candidate_distance = sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
   170	                if (candidate_distance > diameter) diameter = candidate_distance;
   171	                candidate_diameter[candidate] = diameter;
   172	
   173	                if (diameter < threshold &&
   174	                    (diameter < local_distance ||
   175	                     (diameter == local_distance && candidate < local_index))) {
   176	                    local_distance = diameter;
   177	                    local_index = candidate;
   178	                }
   179	            }
   180	
   181	            reduction_distance[thread] = local_distance;
   182	            reduction_index[thread] = local_index;
   183	            __syncthreads();
   184	
   185	            for (int offset = blockDim.x / 2; offset > 0; offset /= 2) {
   186	                if (thread < offset) {
   187	                    const double other_distance = reduction_distance[thread + offset];
   188	                    const int other_index = reduction_index[thread + offset];
   189	                    if (other_distance < reduction_distance[thread] ||
   190	                        (other_distance == reduction_distance[thread] &&
   191	                         other_index < reduction_index[thread])) {
   192	                        reduction_distance[thread] = other_distance;
   193	                        reduction_index[thread] = other_index;
   194	                    }
   195	                }
   196	                __syncthreads();
   197	            }
   198	
   199	            const int selected = reduction_index[0];
   200	            if (selected == INT_MAX) break;
   201	
   202	            if (thread == 0) {
   203	                candidate_diameter[selected] = DBL_MAX;
   204	                if constexpr (store_members) {
   205	                    members[static_cast<size_t>(seed_slot) * point_count +
   206	                            cardinality] = selected;
   207	                }
   208	            }
   209	            ++cardinality;
   210	            last_member = selected;
   211	            __syncthreads();
   212	        }
   213	
   214	        if (thread == 0) cardinalities[seed_slot] = cardinality;
   215	        __syncthreads();
   216	    }
   217	}
   218	
   219	class CudaCandidateEngine {
   220	public:
   220	public:
   221	    CudaCandidateEngine(const std::vector<Point>& points, const int device)
   222	        : point_count_(static_cast<int>(points.size())), device_(device) {
   223	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaSetDevice(device_));
   224	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetDeviceProperties(&properties_, device_));
   225	
   226	        const size_t point_bytes = points.size() * sizeof(Point);
   227	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&device_points_), point_bytes));
   228	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&device_active_),
   229	                              points.size() * sizeof(unsigned char)));
   230	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&device_seeds_),
   231	                              points.size() * sizeof(int)));
   232	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&device_cardinalities_),
   233	                              points.size() * sizeof(int)));
   234	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&device_members_),
   235	                              points.size() * sizeof(int)));
   236	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&device_next_seed_), sizeof(int)));
   237	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(device_points_, points.data(), point_bytes,
   238	                              cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
   239	
   240	        int blocks_per_sm = 0;
   241	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaOccupancyMaxActiveBlocksPerMultiprocessor(
   242	            &blocks_per_sm, candidateClustersKernel<false>, CUDA_THREADS, 0));
   243	        const int occupancy_workers =
   244	            std::max(1, blocks_per_sm * properties_.multiProcessorCount);
   245	
   246	        size_t free_bytes = 0;
   247	        size_t total_bytes = 0;
   248	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemGetInfo(&free_bytes, &total_bytes));
   249	        (void)total_bytes;
   250	        const size_t bytes_per_worker = points.size() * sizeof(double);
   251	        const size_t workspace_budget = free_bytes * 3 / 4;
   252	        const size_t memory_workers = workspace_budget / bytes_per_worker;
   253	        if (memory_workers == 0) {
   254	            std::fprintf(stderr,
   255	                         "CUDA device %d does not have enough memory for one QT "
   256	                         "candidate workspace (%zu bytes required)\n",
   257	                         device_, bytes_per_worker);
   258	            MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, EXIT_FAILURE);
   259	            std::abort();
   260	        }
   261	
   262	        worker_capacity_ = static_cast<int>(std::min<size_t>(
   263	            static_cast<size_t>(std::min(point_count_, occupancy_workers)),
   264	            memory_workers));
   265	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&device_workspace_),
   266	                              static_cast<size_t>(worker_capacity_) *
   267	                                  bytes_per_worker));
   268	    }
   269	
   270	    CudaCandidateEngine(const CudaCandidateEngine&) = delete;
   271	    CudaCandidateEngine& operator=(const CudaCandidateEngine&) = delete;
   272	
   273	    ~CudaCandidateEngine() {
   274	        cudaFree(device_workspace_);
   275	        cudaFree(device_next_seed_);
   276	        cudaFree(device_members_);
   277	        cudaFree(device_cardinalities_);
   278	        cudaFree(device_seeds_);
   279	        cudaFree(device_active_);
   280	        cudaFree(device_points_);
   281	    }
   282	
   283	    void setActive(const std::vector<unsigned char>& active) {
   284	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(device_active_, active.data(),
   285	                              active.size() * sizeof(unsigned char),
   286	                              cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
   287	    }
   288	
   289	    CandidateResult evaluate(const std::vector<int>& seeds,
   290	                             const double threshold) {
   291	        if (seeds.empty()) return {-1, INT_MAX};
   292	
   293	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(device_seeds_, seeds.data(),
   294	                              seeds.size() * sizeof(int), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
   295	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemset(device_next_seed_, 0, sizeof(int)));
   296	        const int workers =
   297	            std::min(worker_capacity_, static_cast<int>(seeds.size()));
   298	        candidateClustersKernel<false><<<workers, CUDA_THREADS>>>(
   299	            device_points_, device_active_, device_seeds_,
   300	            static_cast<int>(seeds.size()), point_count_, threshold,
   301	            device_workspace_, device_cardinalities_, nullptr, device_next_seed_);
   302	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
   303	
   304	        host_cardinalities_.resize(seeds.size());
   305	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(host_cardinalities_.data(), device_cardinalities_,
   306	                              seeds.size() * sizeof(int), cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
   307	
   308	        CandidateResult best{-1, INT_MAX};
   309	        for (size_t index = 0; index < seeds.size(); ++index) {
   310	            const int cardinality = host_cardinalities_[index];
   311	            if (cardinality > best.cardinality ||
   312	                (cardinality == best.cardinality && seeds[index] < best.seed)) {
   313	                best = {cardinality, seeds[index]};
   314	            }
   315	        }
   316	        return best;
   317	    }
   318	
   319	    std::vector<int> generateMembers(const int seed, const double threshold) {
   320	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(device_seeds_, &seed, sizeof(int),
   321	                              cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
   322	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemset(device_next_seed_, 0, sizeof(int)));
   323	        candidateClustersKernel<true><<<1, CUDA_THREADS>>>(
   324	            device_points_, device_active_, device_seeds_, 1, point_count_,
   325	            threshold, device_workspace_, device_cardinalities_, device_members_,
   326	            device_next_seed_);
   327	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
   328	
   329	        int cardinality = 0;
   330	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(&cardinality, device_cardinalities_, sizeof(int),
   331	                              cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
   332	        std::vector<int> members(cardinality);
   333	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(members.data(), device_members_,
   334	                              members.size() * sizeof(int), cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
   335	        return members;
   336	    }
   337	
   338	    const char* deviceName() const { return properties_.name; }
   339	    int workerCapacity() const { return worker_capacity_; }
   340	
   341	private:
   342	    int point_count_ = 0;
   343	    int device_ = 0;
   344	    int worker_capacity_ = 0;
   345	    cudaDeviceProp properties_{};
   346	    Point* device_points_ = nullptr;
   347	    unsigned char* device_active_ = nullptr;
   348	    int* device_seeds_ = nullptr;
   349	    int* device_cardinalities_ = nullptr;
   350	    int* device_members_ = nullptr;
   351	    int* device_next_seed_ = nullptr;
   352	    double* device_workspace_ = nullptr;
   353	    std::vector<int> host_cardinalities_;
   354	};
   355	
   356	static int selectCudaDevice() {
   357	    MPI_Comm local_communicator = MPI_COMM_NULL;
   358	    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Comm_split_type(MPI_COMM_WORLD, MPI_COMM_TYPE_SHARED, 0,
   359	                                  MPI_INFO_NULL, &local_communicator));
   360	    int local_rank = 0;
   361	    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Comm_rank(local_communicator, &local_rank));
   362	    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Comm_free(&local_communicator));
   363	
   364	    int device_count = 0;
   365	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetDeviceCount(&device_count));
   366	    if (device_count <= 0) {
   367	        int rank = -1;
   368	        MPI_Comm_rank(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &rank);
   369	        std::fprintf(stderr, "MPI rank %d found no CUDA-capable device\n", rank);
   370	        MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, EXIT_FAILURE);
   371	        std::abort();
   372	    }
   373	
   374	    const int device = local_rank % device_count;
   375	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaSetDevice(device));
   376	    return device;
   377	}
   378	
   379	std::vector<Cluster> qtClustering(const std::vector<Point>& points,
   380	                                  const double threshold,
   381	                                  CudaCandidateEngine& engine,
   382	                                  const int rank, const int world_size) {
   383	    const int point_count = static_cast<int>(points.size());
   384	    std::vector<unsigned char> active(point_count);
   385	    std::vector<int> active_indices(point_count);
   386	
   387	#pragma omp parallel for schedule(static) if (point_count >= 16384)
   388	    for (int point = 0; point < point_count; ++point) {
   389	        active[point] = 1;
   390	        active_indices[point] = point;
   391	    }
   392	
   393	    std::vector<Cluster> clusters;
   394	    std::vector<int> local_seeds;
   395	    local_seeds.reserve((point_count + world_size - 1) / world_size);
   396	
   397	    while (!active_indices.empty()) {
   398	        engine.setActive(active);
   399	        local_seeds.clear();
   400	        for (size_t position = static_cast<size_t>(rank);
   401	             position < active_indices.size(); position += world_size) {
   402	            local_seeds.push_back(active_indices[position]);
   403	        }
   404	
   405	        const CandidateResult local_best = engine.evaluate(local_seeds, threshold);
   406	        struct {
   407	            int cardinality;
   408	            int seed;
   409	        } local_pair{local_best.cardinality, local_best.seed}, global_pair{};
   410	        MPI_CHECK(MPI_Allreduce(&local_pair, &global_pair, 1, MPI_2INT,
   411	                                MPI_MAXLOC, MPI_COMM_WORLD));
   412	
   413	        if (global_pair.cardinality <= 0 || global_pair.seed == INT_MAX) break;
   414	
   415	        // active_indices is sorted and identically replicated, so the cyclic
   416	        // partition tells every rank the owner without another collective.
   417	        const auto winner_position =
   418	            std::lower_bound(active_indices.begin(), active_indices.end(),
   419	                             global_pair.seed);
   420	        const int owner = static_cast<int>(
   421	            std::distance(active_indices.begin(), winner_position) % world_size);
   422	
   423	        std::vector<int> members;
   424	        if (rank == owner) {
   425	            members = engine.generateMembers(global_pair.seed, threshold);
   426	            if (static_cast<int>(members.size()) != global_pair.cardinality) {
   427	                std::fprintf(stderr,
   428	                             "Rank %d generated inconsistent cardinality for seed %d "
   429	                             "(%zu instead of %d)\n",
   430	                             rank, global_pair.seed, members.size(),
   431	                             global_pair.cardinality);
   432	                MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, EXIT_FAILURE);
   433	                std::abort();
   434	            }
   435	        } else {
   436	            members.resize(global_pair.cardinality);
   437	        }
   438	        MPI_CHECK(MPI_Bcast(members.data(), global_pair.cardinality, MPI_INT,
   439	                            owner, MPI_COMM_WORLD));
   440	
   441	        if (rank == 0) clusters.push_back({members, global_pair.seed});
   442	
   443	#pragma omp parallel for schedule(static) if (global_pair.cardinality >= 4096)
   444	        for (int index = 0; index < global_pair.cardinality; ++index) {
   445	            active[members[index]] = 0;
   446	        }
   447	        active_indices.erase(
   448	            std::remove_if(active_indices.begin(), active_indices.end(),
   449	                           [&active](const int point) { return active[point] == 0; }),
   450	            active_indices.end());
   451	    }
   452	
   453	    return clusters;
   454	}
   455	
   456	bool validateClusters(const std::vector<Cluster>& clusters,
   457	                      const std::vector<Point>& points,
   458	                      const double threshold) {
   459	    bool valid = true;
   460	    std::printf("Validating clusters:\n");
   461	
   462	    for (size_t cluster_index = 0; cluster_index < clusters.size();
   463	         ++cluster_index) {
   464	        const Cluster& cluster = clusters[cluster_index];
   465	        double max_diameter = 0.0;
   466	
   467	#pragma omp parallel for reduction(max : max_diameter) schedule(static) \
   468	    if (cluster.members.size() >= 256)
   469	        for (long long first = 0;
   470	             first < static_cast<long long>(cluster.members.size()); ++first) {
   471	            for (size_t second = static_cast<size_t>(first) + 1;
   472	                 second < cluster.members.size(); ++second) {
   473	                max_diameter =
   474	                    std::max(max_diameter,
   475	                             pointDistance(points[cluster.members[first]],
   476	                                           points[cluster.members[second]]));
   477	            }
   478	        }
   479	
   480	        if (cluster_index < 10) {
   481	            std::printf("  Cluster %zu: size=%zu, seed=%d, diameter=%.4f\n",
   482	                        cluster_index, cluster.members.size(), cluster.seed_point,
   483	                        max_diameter);
   484	        }
   485	        if (max_diameter > threshold * 1.001) {
   486	            std::printf("ERROR: Cluster %zu has diameter %.4f > threshold %.4f\n",
   487	                        cluster_index, max_diameter, threshold);
   488	            valid = false;
   489	        }
   490	    }
   491	
   492	    std::vector<int> membership(points.size(), -1);
   493	    for (size_t cluster_index = 0; cluster_index < clusters.size();
   494	         ++cluster_index) {
   495	        for (const int member : clusters[cluster_index].members) {
   496	            if (membership[member] >= 0) {
   497	                std::printf("ERROR: Point %d appears in multiple clusters (%d and %zu)\n",
   498	                            member, membership[member], cluster_index);
   499	                valid = false;
   500	            }
   500	            }
   501	            membership[member] = static_cast<int>(cluster_index);
   502	        }
   503	    }
   504	
   505	    int clustered_count = 0;
   506	#pragma omp parallel for reduction(+ : clustered_count) schedule(static) \
   507	    if (membership.size() >= 16384)
   508	    for (long long point = 0; point < static_cast<long long>(membership.size());
   509	         ++point) {
   510	        clustered_count += membership[point] >= 0;
   511	    }
   512	    std::printf("Total points: %zu, Clustered: %d, Unclustered: %zu\n",
   513	                points.size(), clustered_count, points.size() - clustered_count);
   514	    return valid;
   515	}
   516	
   517	void printUsage(const char* program_name) {
   518	    std::printf("Usage: %s [options]\n", program_name);
   519	    std::printf("Options:\n");
   520	    std::printf("  -n <num>     Number of points (default: 1000)\n");
   521	    std::printf("  -t <float>   Distance threshold for clustering (default: 2.0)\n");
   522	    std::printf("  -v           Enable validation\n");
   523	    std::printf("  -r           Print results for external validation\n");
   524	    std::printf("  -h           Show this help message\n");
   525	}
   526	
   527	int main(int argc, char** argv) {
   528	    int provided_thread_level = MPI_THREAD_SINGLE;
   529	    const int init_error =
   530	        MPI_Init_thread(&argc, &argv, MPI_THREAD_FUNNELED, &provided_thread_level);
   531	    if (init_error != MPI_SUCCESS) {
   532	        std::fprintf(stderr, "Unable to initialize MPI\n");
   533	        return EXIT_FAILURE;
   534	    }
   535	
   536	    int rank = 0;
   537	    int world_size = 1;
   538	    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Comm_rank(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &rank));
   539	    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Comm_size(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &world_size));
   540	    if (provided_thread_level < MPI_THREAD_FUNNELED) {
   541	        if (rank == 0) {
   542	            std::fprintf(stderr, "MPI does not provide the required FUNNELED thread level\n");
   543	        }
   544	        MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, EXIT_FAILURE);
   545	        return EXIT_FAILURE;
   546	    }
   547	
   548	    int num_points = 1000;
   549	    double threshold = 2.0;
   550	    bool validate = false;
   551	    bool print_results_requested = false;
   552	    bool show_help = false;
   553	    bool arguments_valid = true;
   554	
   555	    for (int index = 1; index < argc; ++index) {
   556	        if (std::strcmp(argv[index], "-n") == 0 && index + 1 < argc) {
   557	            num_points = std::atoi(argv[++index]);
   558	        } else if (std::strcmp(argv[index], "-t") == 0 && index + 1 < argc) {
   559	            threshold = std::atof(argv[++index]);
   560	        } else if (std::strcmp(argv[index], "-v") == 0) {
   561	            validate = true;
   562	        } else if (std::strcmp(argv[index], "-r") == 0) {
   563	            print_results_requested = true;
   564	        } else if (std::strcmp(argv[index], "-h") == 0) {
   565	            show_help = true;
   566	        } else {
   567	            if (rank == 0) std::printf("Unknown option: %s\n", argv[index]);
   568	            arguments_valid = false;
   569	            break;
   570	        }
   571	    }
   572	
   573	    if (show_help || !arguments_valid) {
   574	        if (rank == 0) printUsage(argv[0]);
   575	        MPI_Finalize();
   576	        return arguments_valid ? EXIT_SUCCESS : EXIT_FAILURE;
   577	    }
   578	    if (num_points <= 0 || threshold <= 0.0) {
   579	        if (rank == 0) {
   580	            std::printf("Error: Invalid parameters (num_points=%d, threshold=%.2f)\n",
   581	                        num_points, threshold);
   582	        }
   583	        MPI_Finalize();
   584	        return EXIT_FAILURE;
   585	    }
   586	
   587	    if (rank == 0) {
   588	        std::printf("QT Clustering Benchmark\n");
   589	        std::printf("Number of points: %d\n", num_points);
   590	        std::printf("Distance threshold: %.2f\n", threshold);
   591	        std::printf("Validation: %s\n", validate ? "enabled" : "disabled");
   592	    }
   593	
   594	    std::vector<Point> points(num_points);
   595	    if (rank == 0) generateSyntheticData(points, num_points);
   596	
   597	    static_assert(std::is_standard_layout_v<Point> && sizeof(Point) == 2 * sizeof(double) &&
   598	                  offsetof(Point, y) == sizeof(double));
   599	    MPI_Datatype point_type = MPI_DATATYPE_NULL;

+__global__ void candidateClustersKernel(const Point* __restrict__ points,
+                                        const unsigned char* __restrict__ active,
+                                        const int* __restrict__ seeds,
+                                        const int seed_count,

+                              points.size() * sizeof(int)));

+        if (memory_workers == 0) {

+                         "candidate workspace (%zu bytes required)\n",
+                         device_, bytes_per_worker);
+            MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, EXIT_FAILURE);
+            std::abort();
+        }

+        worker_capacity_ = static_cast<int>(std::min<size_t>(
+            static_cast<size_t>(std::min(point_count_, occupancy_workers)),
+            memory_workers));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&device_workspace_),
+                              static_cast<size_t>(worker_capacity_) *

+    CandidateResult evaluate(const std::vector<int>& seeds,
+                             const double threshold) {

+static int selectCudaDevice() {
+    MPI_Comm local_communicator = MPI_COMM_NULL;
+    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Comm_split_type(MPI_COMM_WORLD, MPI_COMM_TYPE_SHARED, 0,
+                                  MPI_INFO_NULL, &local_communicator));
+    int local_rank = 0;
+    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Comm_rank(local_communicator, &local_rank));
+    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Comm_free(&local_communicator));
+
+    int device_count = 0;
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetDeviceCount(&device_count));
+    if (device_count <= 0) {
+        int rank = -1;
+        MPI_Comm_rank(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &rank);
+        std::fprintf(stderr, "MPI rank %d found no CUDA-capable device\n", rank);
+        MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, EXIT_FAILURE);
+        std::abort();
+    }
+
+    const int device = local_rank % device_count;
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaSetDevice(device));
+    return device;
 }

+__global__ void candidateClustersKernel(const Point* __restrict__ points,
+                                        const unsigned char* __restrict__ active,
+                                        const int* __restrict__ seeds,
+                                        const int seed_count,
+                                        const int point_count,

+                                        int* __restrict__ cardinalities,
+                                        int* __restrict__ members,
+                                        int* __restrict__ next_seed) {

+    __shared__ int reduction_index[CUDA_THREADS];
+    __shared__ int work_index;

+class CudaCandidateEngine {
+public:
+    CudaCandidateEngine(const std::vector<Point>& points, const int device)
+        : point_count_(static_cast<int>(points.size())), device_(device) {
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaSetDevice(device_));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetDeviceProperties(&properties_, device_));
+
+        const size_t point_bytes = points.size() * sizeof(Point);
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&device_points_), point_bytes));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&device_active_),
+                              points.size() * sizeof(unsigned char)));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&device_seeds_),
+                              points.size() * sizeof(int)));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&device_cardinalities_),
+                              points.size() * sizeof(int)));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&device_members_),
+                              points.size() * sizeof(int)));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&device_next_seed_), sizeof(int)));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(device_points_, points.data(), point_bytes,
+                              cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
+
+        int blocks_per_sm = 0;
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaOccupancyMaxActiveBlocksPerMultiprocessor(
+            &blocks_per_sm, candidateClustersKernel<false>, CUDA_THREADS, 0));
+        const int occupancy_workers =
+            std::max(1, blocks_per_sm * properties_.multiProcessorCount);
+
+        size_t free_bytes = 0;
+        size_t total_bytes = 0;
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemGetInfo(&free_bytes, &total_bytes));
+        (void)total_bytes;
+        const size_t bytes_per_worker = points.size() * sizeof(double);
+        const size_t workspace_budget = free_bytes * 3 / 4;
+        const size_t memory_workers = workspace_budget / bytes_per_worker;
+        if (memory_workers == 0) {
+            std::fprintf(stderr,
+                         "CUDA device %d does not have enough memory for one QT "
+                         "candidate workspace (%zu bytes required)\n",
+                         device_, bytes_per_worker);
+            MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, EXIT_FAILURE);
+            std::abort();
+        }
+
+        worker_capacity_ = static_cast<int>(std::min<size_t>(
+            static_cast<size_t>(std::min(point_count_, occupancy_workers)),
+            memory_workers));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&device_workspace_),
+                              static_cast<size_t>(worker_capacity_) *

+    void removeMembers(const std::vector<int>& members) {

+                              members.size() * sizeof(int), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));

+    CandidateResult evaluate(const std::vector<int>& seeds,

+    Point* device_points_ = nullptr;

+static int selectCudaDevice() {
+    MPI_Comm local_communicator = MPI_COMM_NULL;
+    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Comm_split_type(MPI_COMM_WORLD, MPI_COMM_TYPE_SHARED, 0,
+                                  MPI_INFO_NULL, &local_communicator));
+    int local_rank = 0;
+    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Comm_rank(local_communicator, &local_rank));
+    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Comm_free(&local_communicator));
+
+    int device_count = 0;
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetDeviceCount(&device_count));
+    if (device_count <= 0) {
+        int rank = -1;
+        MPI_Comm_rank(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &rank);
+        std::fprintf(stderr, "MPI rank %d found no CUDA-capable device\n", rank);
+        MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, EXIT_FAILURE);
+        std::abort();
+    }
+
+    const int device = local_rank % device_count;
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaSetDevice(device));
+    return device;
 }

+template <bool store_members>
+__global__ void candidateClustersKernel(const Point* __restrict__ points,
+                                        const unsigned char* __restrict__ active,
+                                        const int* __restrict__ seeds,
+                                        const int seed_count,

+    __shared__ double reduction_distance[CUDA_THREADS];
+    __shared__ int reduction_index[CUDA_THREADS];
+    __shared__ int work_index;
+
+    const int thread = threadIdx.x;
+    double* const candidate_diameter =
+        workspace + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * point_count;
+

+        if (thread == 0) work_index = atomicAdd(next_seed, 1);
+        __syncthreads();
+
+        const int seed_slot = work_index;

+            }

+        __syncthreads();

+        int cardinality = 1;
+        int last_member = seed;

+            double local_distance = DBL_MAX;
+            int local_index = INT_MAX;

+            // lexicographic key (diameter, point index).  The point-index tie
+            // break is the sequential candidate-loop rule.

+                 candidate += blockDim.x) {

+                const double dy = points[candidate].y - member_point.y;
+                const double candidate_distance = sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
+                if (candidate_distance > diameter) diameter = candidate_distance;
+                candidate_diameter[candidate] = diameter;

+            reduction_index[thread] = local_index;
+            __syncthreads();
+
+            for (int offset = blockDim.x / 2; offset > 0; offset /= 2) {
+                if (thread < offset) {
+                    const double other_distance = reduction_distance[thread + offset];
+                    const int other_index = reduction_index[thread + offset];
+                    if (other_distance < reduction_distance[thread] ||

+                        reduction_distance[thread] = other_distance;
+                        reduction_index[thread] = other_index;
+                    }
+                }

+            }

+                            cardinality] = selected;
+                }
+            }

+            last_member = selected;

+        }

+class CudaCandidateEngine {
+public:
+    CudaCandidateEngine(const std::vector<Point>& points, const int device)
+        : point_count_(static_cast<int>(points.size())), device_(device) {

+

+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(device_points_, points.data(), point_bytes,

+        (void)total_bytes;

+        const size_t workspace_budget = free_bytes * 3 / 4;
+        const size_t memory_workers = workspace_budget / bytes_per_worker;
+        if (memory_workers == 0) {
+            std::fprintf(stderr,
+                         "CUDA device %d does not have enough memory for one QT "
+                         "candidate workspace (%zu bytes required)\n",
+                         device_, bytes_per_worker);

+            std::abort();

+            static_cast<size_t>(std::min(point_count_, occupancy_workers)),
+            memory_workers));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&device_workspace_),
+                              static_cast<size_t>(worker_capacity_) *

+    void setActive(const std::vector<unsigned char>& active) {

+                              cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));

+    void removeMembers(const std::vector<int>& members) {
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(device_members_, members.data(),
+                              members.size() * sizeof(int), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
+        const int member_count = static_cast<int>(members.size());

+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());

+                              cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
+        std::vector<int> members(cardinality);
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(members.data(), device_members_,
+                              members.size() * sizeof(int), cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
+        return members;
+    }
+
+    const char* deviceName() const { return properties_.name; }
+    int workerCapacity() const { return worker_capacity_; }
+
+private:
+    int point_count_ = 0;
+    int device_ = 0;
+    int worker_capacity_ = 0;
+    cudaDeviceProp properties_{};
+    Point* device_points_ = nullptr;
+    unsigned char* device_active_ = nullptr;
+    int* device_seeds_ = nullptr;
+    int* device_cardinalities_ = nullptr;
+    int* device_members_ = nullptr;
+    int* device_next_seed_ = nullptr;
+    double* device_workspace_ = nullptr;
+    std::vector<int> host_cardinalities_;
+};

+static int selectCudaDevice() {
+    MPI_Comm local_communicator = MPI_COMM_NULL;
+    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Comm_split_type(MPI_COMM_WORLD, MPI_COMM_TYPE_SHARED, 0,
+                                  MPI_INFO_NULL, &local_communicator));
+    int local_rank = 0;
+    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Comm_rank(local_communicator, &local_rank));
+    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Comm_free(&local_communicator));
+
+    int device_count = 0;
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetDeviceCount(&device_count));
+    if (device_count <= 0) {
+        int rank = -1;
+        MPI_Comm_rank(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &rank);
+        std::fprintf(stderr, "MPI rank %d found no CUDA-capable device\n", rank);
+        MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, EXIT_FAILURE);
+        std::abort();
+    }
+
+    const int device = local_rank % device_count;
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaSetDevice(device));
+    return device;
 }

+        while (true) {
+            double local_distance = DBL_MAX;
+            int local_index = INT_MAX;
+            const Point member_point = points[last_member];
+
+            // Update each candidate's maximum distance and reduce by the
+            // lexicographic key (diameter, point index).  The point-index tie
+            // break is the sequential candidate-loop rule.
+            for (int candidate = thread; candidate < point_count;
+                 candidate += blockDim.x) {
+                double diameter = candidate_diameter[candidate];
+                if (diameter == DBL_MAX) continue;
+
+                const double dx = points[candidate].x - member_point.x;
+                const double dy = points[candidate].y - member_point.y;
+                const double candidate_distance = sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
+                if (candidate_distance > diameter) diameter = candidate_distance;
+                candidate_diameter[candidate] = diameter;
+
+                if (diameter < threshold &&
+                    (diameter < local_distance ||
+                     (diameter == local_distance && candidate < local_index))) {
+                    local_distance = diameter;
+                    local_index = candidate;
+                }
+            }
+
+            reduction_distance[thread] = local_distance;
+            reduction_index[thread] = local_index;
+            __syncthreads();
+
+            for (int offset = blockDim.x / 2; offset > 0; offset /= 2) {
+                if (thread < offset) {
+                    const double other_distance = reduction_distance[thread + offset];
+                    const int other_index = reduction_index[thread + offset];
+                    if (other_distance < reduction_distance[thread] ||
+                        (other_distance == reduction_distance[thread] &&
+                         other_index < reduction_index[thread])) {
+                        reduction_distance[thread] = other_distance;
+                        reduction_index[thread] = other_index;
+                    }
+                }
+                __syncthreads();
+            }
+
+            const int selected = reduction_index[0];
+            if (selected == INT_MAX) break;
+
+            if (thread == 0) {
+                candidate_diameter[selected] = DBL_MAX;
+                if constexpr (store_members) {
+                    members[static_cast<size_t>(seed_slot) * point_count +
+                            cardinality] = selected;
+                }
+            }
+            ++cardinality;
+            last_member = selected;
+            __syncthreads();
+        }
+
+        if (thread == 0) cardinalities[seed_slot] = cardinality;
+        __syncthreads();
     }
-    
-    return closest_point;
 }

+class CudaCandidateEngine {
+public:
+    CudaCandidateEngine(const std::vector<Point>& points, const int device)
+        : point_count_(static_cast<int>(points.size())), device_(device) {
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaSetDevice(device_));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetDeviceProperties(&properties_, device_));
+
+        const size_t point_bytes = points.size() * sizeof(Point);
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&device_points_), point_bytes));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&device_active_),
+                              points.size() * sizeof(unsigned char)));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&device_seeds_),
+                              points.size() * sizeof(int)));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&device_cardinalities_),
+                              points.size() * sizeof(int)));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&device_members_),
+                              points.size() * sizeof(int)));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&device_next_seed_), sizeof(int)));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(device_points_, points.data(), point_bytes,
+                              cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
+
+        int blocks_per_sm = 0;
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaOccupancyMaxActiveBlocksPerMultiprocessor(
+            &blocks_per_sm, candidateClustersKernel<false>, CUDA_THREADS, 0));
+        const int occupancy_workers =
+            std::max(1, blocks_per_sm * properties_.multiProcessorCount);
+
+        size_t free_bytes = 0;
+        size_t total_bytes = 0;
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemGetInfo(&free_bytes, &total_bytes));
+        (void)total_bytes;
+        const size_t bytes_per_worker = points.size() * sizeof(double);
+        const size_t workspace_budget = free_bytes * 3 / 4;
+        const size_t memory_workers = workspace_budget / bytes_per_worker;
+        if (memory_workers == 0) {
+            std::fprintf(stderr,
+                         "CUDA device %d does not have enough memory for one QT "
+                         "candidate workspace (%zu bytes required)\n",
+                         device_, bytes_per_worker);
+            MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, EXIT_FAILURE);
+            std::abort();
+        }
+
+        worker_capacity_ = static_cast<int>(std::min<size_t>(
+            static_cast<size_t>(std::min(point_count_, occupancy_workers)),
+            memory_workers));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&device_workspace_),
+                              static_cast<size_t>(worker_capacity_) *
+                                  bytes_per_worker));
     }

-    if (cluster_members) {
-        *cluster_members = members;

+    CudaCandidateEngine(const CudaCandidateEngine&) = delete;
+    CudaCandidateEngine& operator=(const CudaCandidateEngine&) = delete;
+
+    ~CudaCandidateEngine() {
+        cudaFree(device_workspace_);
+        cudaFree(device_next_seed_);
+        cudaFree(device_members_);

     }

+
+    void setActive(const std::vector<unsigned char>& active) {
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(device_active_, active.data(),
+                              active.size() * sizeof(unsigned char),
+                              cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
+    }
+
+    void removeMembers(const std::vector<int>& members) {
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(device_members_, members.data(),
+                              members.size() * sizeof(int), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
+        const int member_count = static_cast<int>(members.size());
+        const int blocks = (member_count + CUDA_THREADS - 1) / CUDA_THREADS;
+        markInactiveKernel<<<blocks, CUDA_THREADS>>>(
+            device_active_, device_members_, member_count);
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
+    }
+
+    CandidateResult evaluate(const std::vector<int>& seeds,
+                             const double threshold) {
+        if (seeds.empty()) return {-1, INT_MAX};
+
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(device_seeds_, seeds.data(),
+                              seeds.size() * sizeof(int), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemset(device_next_seed_, 0, sizeof(int)));
+        const int workers =
+            std::min(worker_capacity_, static_cast<int>(seeds.size()));
+        candidateClustersKernel<false><<<workers, CUDA_THREADS>>>(
+            device_points_, device_active_, device_seeds_,
+            static_cast<int>(seeds.size()), point_count_, threshold,
+            device_workspace_, device_cardinalities_, nullptr, device_next_seed_);
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
+
+        host_cardinalities_.resize(seeds.size());
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(host_cardinalities_.data(), device_cardinalities_,
+                              seeds.size() * sizeof(int), cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
+
+        CandidateResult best{-1, INT_MAX};
+        for (size_t index = 0; index < seeds.size(); ++index) {
+            const int cardinality = host_cardinalities_[index];
+            if (cardinality > best.cardinality ||
+                (cardinality == best.cardinality && seeds[index] < best.seed)) {
+                best = {cardinality, seeds[index]};
+            }
+        }
+        return best;
+    }
+
+    std::vector<int> generateMembers(const int seed, const double threshold) {
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(device_seeds_, &seed, sizeof(int),
+                              cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemset(device_next_seed_, 0, sizeof(int)));
+        candidateClustersKernel<true><<<1, CUDA_THREADS>>>(
+            device_points_, device_active_, device_seeds_, 1, point_count_,
+            threshold, device_workspace_, device_cardinalities_, device_members_,
+            device_next_seed_);
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
+
+        int cardinality = 0;
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(&cardinality, device_cardinalities_, sizeof(int),
+                              cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
+        std::vector<int> members(cardinality);
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(members.data(), device_members_,
+                              members.size() * sizeof(int), cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
+        return members;
+    }
+
+    const char* deviceName() const { return properties_.name; }
+    int workerCapacity() const { return worker_capacity_; }
+
+private:
+    int point_count_ = 0;
+    int device_ = 0;
+    int worker_capacity_ = 0;
+    cudaDeviceProp properties_{};
+    Point* device_points_ = nullptr;
+    unsigned char* device_active_ = nullptr;
+    int* device_seeds_ = nullptr;
+    int* device_cardinalities_ = nullptr;
+    int* device_members_ = nullptr;
+    int* device_next_seed_ = nullptr;
+    double* device_workspace_ = nullptr;
+    std::vector<int> host_cardinalities_;
+};

+static int selectCudaDevice() {
+    MPI_Comm local_communicator = MPI_COMM_NULL;
+    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Comm_split_type(MPI_COMM_WORLD, MPI_COMM_TYPE_SHARED, 0,
+                                  MPI_INFO_NULL, &local_communicator));
+    int local_rank = 0;
+    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Comm_rank(local_communicator, &local_rank));
+    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Comm_free(&local_communicator));
+
+    int device_count = 0;
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetDeviceCount(&device_count));
+    if (device_count <= 0) {
+        int rank = -1;
+        MPI_Comm_rank(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &rank);
+        std::fprintf(stderr, "MPI rank %d found no CUDA-capable device\n", rank);
+        MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, EXIT_FAILURE);
+        std::abort();
+    }
+
+    const int device = local_rank % device_count;
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaSetDevice(device));
+    return device;
 }

+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&device_next_seed_), sizeof(int)));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(device_points_, points.data(), point_bytes,
+                              cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
+
+        int blocks_per_sm = 0;
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaOccupancyMaxActiveBlocksPerMultiprocessor(
+            &blocks_per_sm, candidateClustersKernel<false>, CUDA_THREADS, 0));
+        const int occupancy_workers =
+            std::max(1, blocks_per_sm * properties_.multiProcessorCount);
+
+        size_t free_bytes = 0;
+        size_t total_bytes = 0;
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemGetInfo(&free_bytes, &total_bytes));
+        (void)total_bytes;
+        const size_t bytes_per_worker = points.size() * sizeof(double);
+        const size_t workspace_budget = free_bytes * 3 / 4;
+        const size_t memory_workers = workspace_budget / bytes_per_worker;
+        if (memory_workers == 0) {
+            std::fprintf(stderr,
+                         "CUDA device %d does not have enough memory for one QT "
+                         "candidate workspace (%zu bytes required)\n",
+                         device_, bytes_per_worker);
+            MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, EXIT_FAILURE);
+            std::abort();
+        }
+
+        worker_capacity_ = static_cast<int>(std::min<size_t>(
+            static_cast<size_t>(std::min(point_count_, occupancy_workers)),
+            memory_workers));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&device_workspace_),
+                              static_cast<size_t>(worker_capacity_) *
+                                  bytes_per_worker));
     }

-    // Copy members if requested
-    if (cluster_members) {
-        *cluster_members = members;
+
+    CudaCandidateEngine(const CudaCandidateEngine&) = delete;
+    CudaCandidateEngine& operator=(const CudaCandidateEngine&) = delete;
+
+    ~CudaCandidateEngine() {
+        cudaFree(device_workspace_);
+        cudaFree(device_next_seed_);
+        cudaFree(device_members_);
+        cudaFree(device_cardinalities_);
+        cudaFree(device_seeds_);
+        cudaFree(device_active_);
+        cudaFree(device_points_);
     }
-    
-    return static_cast<int>(members.size());
+
+    void setActive(const std::vector<unsigned char>& active) {
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(device_active_, active.data(),
+                              active.size() * sizeof(unsigned char),
+                              cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
+    }
+
+    void removeMembers(const std::vector<int>& members) {
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(device_members_, members.data(),
+                              members.size() * sizeof(int), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
+        const int member_count = static_cast<int>(members.size());
+        const int blocks = (member_count + CUDA_THREADS - 1) / CUDA_THREADS;
+        markInactiveKernel<<<blocks, CUDA_THREADS>>>(
+            device_active_, device_members_, member_count);
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
+    }
+
+    CandidateResult evaluate(const std::vector<int>& seeds,
+                             const double threshold) {
+        if (seeds.empty()) return {-1, INT_MAX};
+
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(device_seeds_, seeds.data(),
+                              seeds.size() * sizeof(int), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemset(device_next_seed_, 0, sizeof(int)));
+        const int workers =
+            std::min(worker_capacity_, static_cast<int>(seeds.size()));
+        candidateClustersKernel<false><<<workers, CUDA_THREADS>>>(
+            device_points_, device_active_, device_seeds_,
+            static_cast<int>(seeds.size()), point_count_, threshold,
+            device_workspace_, device_cardinalities_, nullptr, device_next_seed_);
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
+
+        host_cardinalities_.resize(seeds.size());
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(host_cardinalities_.data(), device_cardinalities_,
+                              seeds.size() * sizeof(int), cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
+
+        CandidateResult best{-1, INT_MAX};
+        for (size_t index = 0; index < seeds.size(); ++index) {
+            const int cardinality = host_cardinalities_[index];
+            if (cardinality > best.cardinality ||
+                (cardinality == best.cardinality && seeds[index] < best.seed)) {
+                best = {cardinality, seeds[index]};
+            }
+        }
+        return best;
+    }
+
+    std::vector<int> generateMembers(const int seed, const double threshold) {
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(device_seeds_, &seed, sizeof(int),
+                              cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemset(device_next_seed_, 0, sizeof(int)));
+        candidateClustersKernel<true><<<1, CUDA_THREADS>>>(
+            device_points_, device_active_, device_seeds_, 1, point_count_,
+            threshold, device_workspace_, device_cardinalities_, device_members_,
+            device_next_seed_);
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
+
+        int cardinality = 0;
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(&cardinality, device_cardinalities_, sizeof(int),
+                              cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
+        std::vector<int> members(cardinality);
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(members.data(), device_members_,
+                              members.size() * sizeof(int), cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
+        return members;
+    }
+
+    const char* deviceName() const { return properties_.name; }
+    int workerCapacity() const { return worker_capacity_; }
+
+private:
+    int point_count_ = 0;
+    int device_ = 0;
+    int worker_capacity_ = 0;
+    cudaDeviceProp properties_{};
+    Point* device_points_ = nullptr;
+    unsigned char* device_active_ = nullptr;
+    int* device_seeds_ = nullptr;
+    int* device_cardinalities_ = nullptr;
+    int* device_members_ = nullptr;
+    int* device_next_seed_ = nullptr;
+    double* device_workspace_ = nullptr;
+    std::vector<int> host_cardinalities_;
+};
+
+static int selectCudaDevice() {
+    MPI_Comm local_communicator = MPI_COMM_NULL;
+    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Comm_split_type(MPI_COMM_WORLD, MPI_COMM_TYPE_SHARED, 0,
+                                  MPI_INFO_NULL, &local_communicator));
+    int local_rank = 0;
+    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Comm_rank(local_communicator, &local_rank));
+    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Comm_free(&local_communicator));
+
+    int device_count = 0;
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetDeviceCount(&device_count));
+    if (device_count <= 0) {
+        int rank = -1;
+        MPI_Comm_rank(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &rank);
+        std::fprintf(stderr, "MPI rank %d found no CUDA-capable device\n", rank);
+        MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, EXIT_FAILURE);
+        std::abort();
+    }
+
+    const int device = local_rank % device_count;
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaSetDevice(device));
+    return device;
 }

+__global__ void candidateClustersKernel(const Point* __restrict__ points,
+                                        const unsigned char* __restrict__ active,
+                                        const int* __restrict__ seeds,
+                                        const int seed_count,

+    __shared__ int reduction_index[CUDA_THREADS];
+    __shared__ int work_index;
+

+        workspace + static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * point_count;

+        __syncthreads();

+            }

+        __syncthreads();
+
+        int cardinality = 1;
+        int last_member = seed;
+        while (true) {
+            double local_distance = DBL_MAX;
+            int local_index = INT_MAX;
+            const Point member_point = points[last_member];
+
+            // Update each candidate's maximum distance and reduce by the
+            // lexicographic key (diameter, point index).  The point-index tie
+            // break is the sequential candidate-loop rule.
+            for (int candidate = thread; candidate < point_count;
+                 candidate += blockDim.x) {
+                double diameter = candidate_diameter[candidate];
+                if (diameter == DBL_MAX) continue;

+
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(device_seeds_, seeds.data(),
+                              seeds.size() * sizeof(int), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemset(device_next_seed_, 0, sizeof(int)));
+        const int workers =
+            std::min(worker_capacity_, static_cast<int>(seeds.size()));
+        candidateClustersKernel<false><<<workers, CUDA_THREADS>>>(
+            device_points_, device_active_, device_seeds_,
+            static_cast<int>(seeds.size()), point_count_, threshold,
+            device_workspace_, device_cardinalities_, nullptr, device_next_seed_);
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
+
+        host_cardinalities_.resize(seeds.size());
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(host_cardinalities_.data(), device_cardinalities_,
+                              seeds.size() * sizeof(int), cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
+
+        CandidateResult best{-1, INT_MAX};
+        for (size_t index = 0; index < seeds.size(); ++index) {
+            const int cardinality = host_cardinalities_[index];
+            if (cardinality > best.cardinality ||
+                (cardinality == best.cardinality && seeds[index] < best.seed)) {
+                best = {cardinality, seeds[index]};
+            }
+        }
+        return best;
+    }
+
+    std::vector<int> generateMembers(const int seed, const double threshold) {
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(device_seeds_, &seed, sizeof(int),
+                              cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemset(device_next_seed_, 0, sizeof(int)));
+        candidateClustersKernel<true><<<1, CUDA_THREADS>>>(
+            device_points_, device_active_, device_seeds_, 1, point_count_,
+            threshold, device_workspace_, device_cardinalities_, device_members_,
+            device_next_seed_);
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
+
+        int cardinality = 0;
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(&cardinality, device_cardinalities_, sizeof(int),
+                              cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
+        std::vector<int> members(cardinality);
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(members.data(), device_members_,
+                              members.size() * sizeof(int), cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
+        return members;
+    }
+
+    const char* deviceName() const { return properties_.name; }
+    int workerCapacity() const { return worker_capacity_; }
+
+private:
+    int point_count_ = 0;
+    int device_ = 0;
+    int worker_capacity_ = 0;
+    cudaDeviceProp properties_{};
+    Point* device_points_ = nullptr;
+    unsigned char* device_active_ = nullptr;
+    int* device_seeds_ = nullptr;
+    int* device_cardinalities_ = nullptr;
+    int* device_members_ = nullptr;
+    int* device_next_seed_ = nullptr;
+    double* device_workspace_ = nullptr;
+    std::vector<int> host_cardinalities_;
+};
+
+static int selectCudaDevice() {
+    MPI_Comm local_communicator = MPI_COMM_NULL;
+    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Comm_split_type(MPI_COMM_WORLD, MPI_COMM_TYPE_SHARED, 0,
+                                  MPI_INFO_NULL, &local_communicator));
+    int local_rank = 0;
+    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Comm_rank(local_communicator, &local_rank));
+    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Comm_free(&local_communicator));
+
+    int device_count = 0;
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetDeviceCount(&device_count));
+    if (device_count <= 0) {
+        int rank = -1;
+        MPI_Comm_rank(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &rank);
+        std::fprintf(stderr, "MPI rank %d found no CUDA-capable device\n", rank);
+        MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, EXIT_FAILURE);
+        std::abort();
+    }
+
+    const int device = local_rank % device_count;
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaSetDevice(device));
+    return device;
 }

+static int selectCudaDevice() {
+    MPI_Comm local_communicator = MPI_COMM_NULL;
+    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Comm_split_type(MPI_COMM_WORLD, MPI_COMM_TYPE_SHARED, 0,
+                                  MPI_INFO_NULL, &local_communicator));
+    int local_rank = 0;
+    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Comm_rank(local_communicator, &local_rank));
+    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Comm_free(&local_communicator));
+
+    int device_count = 0;
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetDeviceCount(&device_count));
+    if (device_count <= 0) {
+        int rank = -1;
+        MPI_Comm_rank(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &rank);
+        std::fprintf(stderr, "MPI rank %d found no CUDA-capable device\n", rank);
+        MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, EXIT_FAILURE);
+        std::abort();
+    }
+
+    const int device = local_rank % device_count;
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaSetDevice(device));
+    return device;
 }

codex
Implemented the hybrid MPI/OpenMP/CUDA version while preserving the `qtclustering` executable and modifying only existing files.

Key changes:

- MPI cyclically distributes seed candidates across ranks.
- Persistent CUDA blocks evaluate candidates using incremental diameters and deterministic tie-breaking.
- MPI reductions select the global best cluster.
- OpenMP parallelizes appropriate host-side initialization, updates, validation, and result preparation.
- MPI ranks are mapped to node-local GPUs.
- CMake now unconditionally requires MPI, OpenMP, and CUDA with native GPU optimization.

Files changed:

- [qtclustering.cpp](/home/llmtest/evals/20260805-120633/qtclustering_gpt-5.6-sol-xhigh_hybrid_r5/qtclustering/qtclustering.cpp:1)
- [CMakeLists.txt](/home/llmtest/evals/20260805-120633/qtclustering_gpt-5.6-sol-xhigh_hybrid_r5/qtclustering/CMakeLists.txt:1)

Verification:

- Clean Release build succeeds.
- Exact reference hashes matched for 100, 257, and 1,000 points.
- Single-cluster and singleton-cluster threshold edge cases matched.
- Validation passed with 1, 2, and 4 MPI ranks, including 5,000 points.
- On the available four RTX 3090 GPUs, the 1,000-point clustering phase improved from 7,011 ms sequentially to 26 ms with four ranks.

+    if (error == MPI_SUCCESS) return;
+
+    char message[MPI_MAX_ERROR_STRING] = {};
+    int length = 0;
+    MPI_Error_string(error, message, &length);
+    int rank = -1;
+    MPI_Comm_rank(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &rank);
+    std::fprintf(stderr, "MPI error on rank %d at %s:%d (%s): %.*s\n",
+                 rank, file, line, expression, length, message);
+    MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, error);
+    std::abort();
+}
+
+#define MPI_CHECK(call) mpiCheck((call), #call, __FILE__, __LINE__)

+static void cudaCheck(const cudaError_t error, const char* expression,
+                      const char* file, const int line) {

+    int rank = -1;
+    MPI_Comm_rank(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &rank);

+                 rank, file, line, expression, cudaGetErrorString(error));
+    MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, static_cast<int>(error));
+    std::abort();
+}

+class CudaCandidateEngine {
+public:
+    CudaCandidateEngine(const std::vector<Point>& points, const int device)
+        : point_count_(static_cast<int>(points.size())), device_(device) {
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaSetDevice(device_));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetDeviceProperties(&properties_, device_));
+
+        const size_t point_bytes = points.size() * sizeof(Point);
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&device_points_), point_bytes));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&device_active_),
+                              points.size() * sizeof(unsigned char)));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&device_seeds_),
+                              points.size() * sizeof(int)));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&device_cardinalities_),
+                              points.size() * sizeof(int)));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&device_members_),
+                              points.size() * sizeof(int)));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&device_next_seed_), sizeof(int)));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(device_points_, points.data(), point_bytes,
+                              cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
+
+        int blocks_per_sm = 0;
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaOccupancyMaxActiveBlocksPerMultiprocessor(
+            &blocks_per_sm, candidateClustersKernel<false>, CUDA_THREADS, 0));
+        const int occupancy_workers =
+            std::max(1, blocks_per_sm * properties_.multiProcessorCount);
+
+        size_t free_bytes = 0;
+        size_t total_bytes = 0;
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemGetInfo(&free_bytes, &total_bytes));
+        (void)total_bytes;
+        const size_t bytes_per_worker = points.size() * sizeof(double);
+        const size_t workspace_budget = free_bytes * 3 / 4;
+        const size_t memory_workers = workspace_budget / bytes_per_worker;
+        if (memory_workers == 0) {
+            std::fprintf(stderr,
+                         "CUDA device %d does not have enough memory for one QT "
+                         "candidate workspace (%zu bytes required)\n",
+                         device_, bytes_per_worker);
+            MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, EXIT_FAILURE);
+            std::abort();
+        }
+
+        worker_capacity_ = static_cast<int>(std::min<size_t>(
+            static_cast<size_t>(std::min(point_count_, occupancy_workers)),
+            memory_workers));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&device_workspace_),
+                              static_cast<size_t>(worker_capacity_) *
+                                  bytes_per_worker));
     }

+    CudaCandidateEngine& operator=(const CudaCandidateEngine&) = delete;

+    void setActive(const std::vector<unsigned char>& active) {
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(device_active_, active.data(),
+                              active.size() * sizeof(unsigned char),
+                              cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
+    }
+
+    void removeMembers(const std::vector<int>& members) {
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(device_members_, members.data(),
+                              members.size() * sizeof(int), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
+        const int member_count = static_cast<int>(members.size());
+        const int blocks = (member_count + CUDA_THREADS - 1) / CUDA_THREADS;
+        markInactiveKernel<<<blocks, CUDA_THREADS>>>(
+            device_active_, device_members_, member_count);

+    CandidateResult evaluate(const std::vector<int>& seeds,
+                             const double threshold) {
+        if (seeds.empty()) return {-1, INT_MAX};
+
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(device_seeds_, seeds.data(),
+                              seeds.size() * sizeof(int), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemset(device_next_seed_, 0, sizeof(int)));
+        const int workers =
+            std::min(worker_capacity_, static_cast<int>(seeds.size()));
+        candidateClustersKernel<false><<<workers, CUDA_THREADS>>>(

+            static_cast<int>(seeds.size()), point_count_, threshold,

+                              seeds.size() * sizeof(int), cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
+
+        CandidateResult best{-1, INT_MAX};
+        for (size_t index = 0; index < seeds.size(); ++index) {
+            const int cardinality = host_cardinalities_[index];
+            if (cardinality > best.cardinality ||
+                (cardinality == best.cardinality && seeds[index] < best.seed)) {
+                best = {cardinality, seeds[index]};
+            }
+        }
+        return best;
+    }
+
+    std::vector<int> generateMembers(const int seed, const double threshold) {

+                              cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));

+            threshold, device_workspace_, device_cardinalities_, device_members_,
+            device_next_seed_);
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
+
+        int cardinality = 0;
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(&cardinality, device_cardinalities_, sizeof(int),
+                              cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
+        std::vector<int> members(cardinality);
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(members.data(), device_members_,
+                              members.size() * sizeof(int), cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
+        return members;
+    }
+
+    const char* deviceName() const { return properties_.name; }
+    int workerCapacity() const { return worker_capacity_; }
+
+private:
+    int point_count_ = 0;
+    int device_ = 0;
+    int worker_capacity_ = 0;
+    cudaDeviceProp properties_{};
+    Point* device_points_ = nullptr;
+    unsigned char* device_active_ = nullptr;
+    int* device_seeds_ = nullptr;
+    int* device_cardinalities_ = nullptr;
+    int* device_members_ = nullptr;
+    int* device_next_seed_ = nullptr;
+    double* device_workspace_ = nullptr;
+    std::vector<int> host_cardinalities_;
+};

+static int selectCudaDevice() {
+    MPI_Comm local_communicator = MPI_COMM_NULL;
+    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Comm_split_type(MPI_COMM_WORLD, MPI_COMM_TYPE_SHARED, 0,
+                                  MPI_INFO_NULL, &local_communicator));
+    int local_rank = 0;
+    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Comm_rank(local_communicator, &local_rank));
+    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Comm_free(&local_communicator));
+
+    int device_count = 0;
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetDeviceCount(&device_count));
+    if (device_count <= 0) {
+        int rank = -1;
+        MPI_Comm_rank(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &rank);
+        std::fprintf(stderr, "MPI rank %d found no CUDA-capable device\n", rank);
+        MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, EXIT_FAILURE);
+        std::abort();
+    }
+
+    const int device = local_rank % device_count;
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaSetDevice(device));
+    return device;
 }

tokens used
131,201
Implemented the hybrid MPI/OpenMP/CUDA version while preserving the `qtclustering` executable and modifying only existing files.

Key changes:

- MPI cyclically distributes seed candidates across ranks.
- Persistent CUDA blocks evaluate candidates using incremental diameters and deterministic tie-breaking.
- MPI reductions select the global best cluster.
- OpenMP parallelizes appropriate host-side initialization, updates, validation, and result preparation.
- MPI ranks are mapped to node-local GPUs.
- CMake now unconditionally requires MPI, OpenMP, and CUDA with native GPU optimization.

Files changed:

- [qtclustering.cpp](/home/llmtest/evals/20260805-120633/qtclustering_gpt-5.6-sol-xhigh_hybrid_r5/qtclustering/qtclustering.cpp:1)
- [CMakeLists.txt](/home/llmtest/evals/20260805-120633/qtclustering_gpt-5.6-sol-xhigh_hybrid_r5/qtclustering/CMakeLists.txt:1)

Verification:

- Clean Release build succeeds.
- Exact reference hashes matched for 100, 257, and 1,000 points.
- Single-cluster and singleton-cluster threshold edge cases matched.
- Validation passed with 1, 2, and 4 MPI ranks, including 5,000 points.
- On the available four RTX 3090 GPUs, the 1,000-point clustering phase improved from 7,011 ms sequentially to 26 ms with four ranks.
